items.title: Colour Patch
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Want to stick out among your friends? These colourful skins will help you do just that!

*10 colourful skins
*1 free skin

items.title: Monthly Me
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
New Month. New Mood. New You.
Who will you be today?

*12 teen skins
*2 free skins

items.title: Cute Dinosaurs
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Explore a whole new world full of cute dinosaurs! You are able to dress, hatch, ride, train, tame and fly these Cute Dinosaurs! Treat them as pets and discover their unique special abilities! 

+ 20 cute dinosaurs!
+ Customize your own dinosaur!
+ Hatch cute dinosaur eggs!
+ Discover different special abilities!

items.title: Adventure Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
It's time to leave the house and head out on an adventure of your own with these curious teens!

*16 adventure teens
*2 free skins

items.title: Mob Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Trick your friends into thinking you're a creeper, or dress up as an adorable fox. The choice is yours to make with this pack!

*12 mob teens
*2 free skins

items.title: Demon Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
From the depths below, these teens have risen. Beware the Demon Teens!

*10 demon teens
*1 free skin

items.title: Cyborgs
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Get ready for an upgrade, and become more than just a human. Cyborgs are the way of the future!

*12 cyborg skins
*2 free skins

items.title: Hackers
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Join the digital world's most elite computer hackers with the 'Hackers' skinset! With these masks, no one will know who we are!

- 8 different hacker skins, equipped headsets!
- Different designs and tech styles!

items.title: Demon Agents
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These demon teens have new suits, and are ready to spy! Watch out for their horns, they're sharp!

- 8 demon skins with a variety of suit designs
- Formal attire perfect for agents, important business, spying, or just looking fancy!

items.title: Parkour Teen Gamers
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Equip one of these skins made for those who love to game and jump through hoops!

- 10 parkour gamer skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Back To School Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Time to go back to school! Don't worry, we promise you'll love every single bit of it.
After all, it's the Minecraft School you're going to attend today!

+ 12 exclusive teens, going to attend cool Minecraft classes on any world!
+ Prepare to use your top-notch Minecraft skills and excel in all the subjects.
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Winter Mobs 2 HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
New winter changing mobs have emerged! Dress up as 6 different winter themed mobs with cozy cold fashion. Be a Ghast, Cow, Fox, Spider, Panda, or Zombie!

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Anime Demons
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The anime demons have been summoned!
Now they are on their way to drive the world into darkness!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Epic Heroes
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Become the crime fighting hero you always wanted to be! Show your friends how awesome you are with these superhero skins!

- includes 8 superhero skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Mobs in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These mobs in fancy suits mean business! These mobs are stealing blocks from Minecraft noobs!

This roleplay skin pack includes the following mob skins:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Zombified Piglin
- Skeleton
- Spider
- Ghast
- Slime

items.title: Ring's Palace
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description:
Find the Ring's Palace! One of the most luxurious places in the world. You can also have a lot of fun here!

+ An incredible luxurious isolated palace with plenty of rooms to explore!
+ Find the parkour.

items.title: Bunker Base Busters
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
They abandoned their bases? That means it's prime time to loot and take over! Come on buster! Let's find out what goods they've been hiding from us all!

- 3 fully explorable bunker bases
- Make the base your own!
- Hidden end portal

items.title: Young Colorful Teens 2
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
These young colorful teens are back at it again with those bright colors! Wear the most bright and colorful outfit around and enjoy roleplaying with your friends with these sweet skins!

- 9 young colorful teens skins!
- Ideal for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion & Smiley Team

items.title: Japan Empire
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Sit on the finest throne in ancient Japan. Role-play as royalty and become an empress or emperor in crown and gown. Choose from 12 fancy skins in really regal looks. Rule the land as its elegant leader and your family by your side.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Teen Billionaires
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Look and feel like a billion bucks! In designer clothes and the latest styles, role-play like the richest teens in Minecraft. Lots of luxurious skins here that show off your wealth and and riches. Don’t forget the dark shades-you don’t want everyone to know who you are.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Animal Skins Bundle
items.creator: House of How
items.description: It’s a critter cataclysm! A blast of beasts! An animal avalanche of puppies and pigs, birds and bunnies, cows and owls and boars oh my! Surf the rainbow wave of multicolored rabbits as more and more creatures pour into an ocean of fluffy cuteness! Play poker with pleasant pugs in disguises, costumes, and dinosaur outfits! A massive mountain of 41 skins, unicorns included!

items.title: Moborgs 2
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The sky darkens with invading ships, one signal jams every method of communication: “Resistance is useless!” This quadrant oozes with cybernetic slime, overrun with bionic ghasts leading armies of mechanical zombies! Frankenstein combinations of mob and machine invite you to get into these 11 robotic skins and explore!

items.title: Monsters
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: Monsters are on the loose! Bold, uncontrolled, and disturbed among us. They're hungry and eager to scare. Unspeakable events to come if they are not caught soon! 11 terrifying skins to contain. Can you do it?

items.title: Emoji Ninjas
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: Hi-YAH! Ready to have a kung fu-n time? These 8 crazy, happy, emojis ninjas sure are. Get to the karate choppa! Grab your own emoji ninja pack today and go "cowabunga"!
